newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 1.41 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 1.41 pct.

text.p: Shares in Pakistan's Dewan Salman Fibre rose 0.50 rupee, or 1.41 percent, to 35.90 on Monday after local producers raised polyester staple fibre (PSF) prices, dealers said.
Dewan Salman Fibre was the most heavily traded stock on the Karachi bourse in early trade with turnover of about 1,022,000 shares.

"The PSF manufacturers raised PSF prices by nine rupees to 81 per kg in a meeting held last week which boosted the entire synthetic sector," a dealer at Amanullah Suleman Securities said. "People expect the earnings of synthetic companies will increase."
